selection_scope.final_reporting_rule: retain every preregistered training seed as a replicate; never choose the best seed after validation or final-test evaluation

candidate_set.source: all checkpoints emitted by the algorithm-specific preregistered checkpoint schedule

metric_semantics.joint_feasible_rule: checkpoint is jointly feasible iff all three registered eta levels are feasible
metric_semantics.mean_irrigation_metric: arithmetic mean total seasonal IRCM across the 15 validation weather-target cells, with each eta and weather year equally weighted

feasible_checkpoint_order: minimum mean validation total irrigation across all 15 cells
maximum minimum risk margin across eta levels
maximum mean risk margin across eta levels
no_jointly_feasible_fallback_order: minimum worst positive risk shortfall across eta levels
minimum mean positive risk shortfall across eta levels
minimum mean validation total irrigation across all 15 cells
maximum minimum risk margin across eta levels
selection_rule.fallback_interpretation: A fallback checkpoint remains scientifically infeasible. Selection only defines a deterministic representative when training never produced a jointly feasible checkpoint; it does not convert failure into success.

evaluation_mode.policy_action_mode: must be declared in the algorithm-specific protocol before training and then held identical for every candidate checkpoint and final evaluation
evaluation_mode.environment_determinism: same frozen DSSAT/agricultural/weather protocol for every candidate
evaluation_mode.repeated_stochastic_rollouts: if an algorithm uses stochastic evaluation, rollout replication count and evaluation seeds must be frozen before training; checkpoint selection code itself must not change based on observed validation outcomes

required_pre_final_freeze: selected checkpoint for every training seed

change_rule: Any change to checkpoint candidacy, validation metrics, lexicographic ordering, seed handling or fallback semantics after PPO training begins requires a new evaluation-contract version and cannot overwrite v1.
